svg.title: DONGKER eight-channel optocoupler isolation module connection groups
svg.desc: A real product photograph with the isolated field terminals and ESP32 logic terminals identified. The field supply and ESP32 supply remain electrically separate.
svg.text: Real product image | DONGKER B08LVXX6MV listing
Power from an isolated 5 V supply.
Dry contacts pull INx to ISO 0 V.
Never connect ISO 0 V to ESP32 GND.
Each OUTx connects to one GPIO.
NPN mode: keep ISO +5 V / ISO 0 V separate from ESP32 3.3 V / GND
